answer: Reputation-weighted work routing. New identities enter a fixed opal tier where every completed task is escrowed for sixty days and released only if a distinct counterparty confirms it, so each clone drags a sixty-day cash delay with no borrowing against it. Forged confirmations feed a spiral of decaying weight: when a cluster's mutual confirmations exceed 15% of its volume, all cluster task weights halve retroactively, wiping the escrowed value. An attacker therefore pays the full task cost per clone plus a 60-day capital lock whose recovery odds fall as the vine of fake counterparties grows.
